evals.name: task-sorted-diff
evals.prompt: Use the bash-shortening skill to shorten evals/files/sorted-diff.sh. Keep its behavior identical, error paths included. Apply every change you judge safe without asking me. Edit evals/files/sorted-diff.sh in place. Then list each change with its reason.
evals.expected_output: The rewritten sorted-diff.sh drops the three /tmp files in favor of process substitution or a pipeline, replaces the expr counters and the echo|cut first-character test with Bash built-ins, and keeps set -euo pipefail and the header comment. Because a failed sort inside <(...) does not stop the script, the rewrite keeps a check that both input files are readable, so a missing input still fails. The response lists each change with a one-line reason.
assertions: The rewritten sorted-diff.sh contains no /tmp path and no rm of a temp file.
The rewritten sorted-diff.sh contains no expr and no echo | cut pipeline.
The rewritten sorted-diff.sh keeps set -euo pipefail and the header comment.
The response names the exit-status difference between temp files and process substitution and says how the rewrite keeps a missing input file fatal.
The response lists each change with its reason.
